$comment: The processes Dyno may start, for scripts/vm-smoke (docs: scripts/vm-smoke/README.md). Each process is Contents/MacOS/<name> of the installed bundle. parents: who may be its parent (app = the app process; launchd = parent pid 1, allowed only while Launch at login is on). argsPattern keeps the CLI calls of the check itself (dyno-agent status) out of the count. stateFiles name the discovery file the app finds its helper by: the pid in it must be the one live helper, and it is gone after Quit. ready: a command that exits 0 once the helper answers.
